blocks.text: VCM The Celebrity Source marks its 26th anniversary this month with heartfelt gratitude to the celebrities, influencers, brands, and creative agencies who have been part of its journey. Founded by Elizabeth “Betchay” Vidanes, VCM has spent 26 years connecting brands with the right personalities to create meaningful, effective partnerships. As the industry evolves beyond traditional endorsements into social media, and as consumer behavior and marketing platforms continue to change, brands face increasing pressure to stand out, build trust, and turn awareness into meaningful engagement.
